parameters.help_en: The streaming domain name. You can query data for multiple domain names at a time. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). If this parameter is left empty, the aggregated data of all domain names is returned by default
parameters.help_zh: 播流域名。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用英文逗号（,）分隔。若参数为空，默认返回所有域名合并后数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. If you do not specify this parameter, the system reads the data from the past 24 hours by default. The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 不填默认读取过去24小时数据，最小数据粒度为5分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the data to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间需大于起始时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity of the data to query. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

300

3600

86400
If the time range is less than or equal to 3 days, the supported data timestamp granularities are 300, 3600, and 86400.
If the time range is greater than 3 days and less than or equal to 31 days, the supported data timestamp granularities are 3600 and 86400.
If the time range is greater than 31 days, the supported data timestamp granularity is 86400.
If this parameter is not specified or the specified value is not supported, the default value 300 is used
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒（s）。取值：

300

3600

86400
数据间隔≤3天，支持数据时间粒度300、3600、86400。
3天＜数据间隔≤31天，支持数据时间粒度3600和86400。
数据间隔＞31天，支持数据时间粒度86400。
不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值300
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the Internet service provider (ISP). If you do not specify this parameter, all ISPs are queried.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query the English names of regions and ISPs
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名，不传为所有运营商。
您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获取区域英文名和运营商英文名
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the region. If you do not specify this parameter, all regions are queried.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query the English names of regions and ISPs
parameters.help_zh:
区域英文名，不传为所有区域 。
您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获取区域英文名和运营商英文名
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The query dimension. Valid values:

Network layer: IPv4 and IPv6

Application layer: HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC

all: all layers. This is the default value.

Valid values: all | IPv4 | IPv6 | http | https | quic. The values are case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
查询维度。可选：

网络层（IPv4、IPv6）

应用层（http、https、quic）

all（默认为all）

允许值：all | IPv4 | IPv6 | http | https | quic（大小写敏感）
